item.title: Four stages of an AI-native startup, and what each one has to prove
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the playbook turns startup work into four gates, each with a question that takes a yes or a no. Once building got cheap, the failures piled up on the gate side. 1. Four gates, laid out# The document runs 36 pages and 7 chapters. Its skeleton is four stages.
